rules.name: Scroll of Desiccation
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: Permanent.
During Pre-game Selections, choose a Field, Forest, Water Terrain, that has not been placed during Pre-game selections: it ceases to be the Terrain Feature it used to be and loses its Terrain Rules. 
 It becomes a Desert Terrain Feature with Dangerous Terrain (6+) for all enemy units.

rules.name: Banner of the Entombed
rules.description:
-1. The bearer counts towards Entombed.
 If taken by a Character, the bearer gains Ambush (Open Terrain). 
 If taken by a Rank-and-File model, the bearer’s unit gains Ambush (Open Terrain), and additional models cannot be added to the unit during Army List creation.

rules.name: Sigil of the Closed Gates
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains +1 Mob and Ghost Step.

rules.name: Envoy's Banner
rules.description:
All models in the bearer’s unit gain Autonomous. 
In addition: One use only. Duration: One Turn. 
During a friendly Movement Phase, the bearer’s unit's Mob is set to 8.

rules.name: Godslayer
rules.description:
+1 Att, Divine Attacks, Multiple Wounds (2, against Aegis (X+)*).
 *Note that the latter also applies towards models with Aegis Saves with conditional applications.

rules.name: Scourge of Kings
rules.description: Attack Value is set to 6, Zeal (against Characters).

rules.name: Crown of the Pharaohs
rules.description:
At the start of every friendly Player Turn, the wearer may lose Undying Will. 
 If so, choose a friendly unit within 12": this unit gains Undying Will, with Duration: One Turn.

rules.name: Sacred Hourglass
rules.description: The first time each Magic Phase that the bearer fails a Casting Roll for a Learned Spell that was targeting a friendly unit, the bearer may reroll all Magic Dice for this Casting Roll.

rules.name: Book of the Dead
rules.description:
The bearer can cast a unique Bound Spell:
Unfinished Duty: Casting Value (4+), Range 12", Aura, Augment. Duration: Instant. 
Choose one of the following effects for each target: 
 • The Rank-and-File part of the target Raises a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value. 
 • One model in the target Recovers a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value.

rules.name: Kherp Sceptre
rules.description:
The wielder gains Hierophant. 
In addition, the wielder can cast Danse Macabre (Evocation) as a Bound Spell (3+).

rules.name: Blessed Wrappings
rules.description: The wearer gains +1 HP and loses one instance of Weakness (Flaming Attacks).

rules.name: Sandstorm Cloak
rules.description: The wearer’s Mobility is set to 8, and gains Autonomous, Fly, Sweeping Attack (2D6, Str 2, AP 1).

sharedRules.name: Commander of the Terracotta Army
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Terracotta Army, and a Pharaoh must be the General. 
Other units in the Army List must be upgraded with Terracotta Army.

sharedRules.name: Lord of the Barrow Legion
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Barrow Legion, and a Pharaoh must be the General.
Other units in the Army List must be upgraded with Barrow Legion.

sharedRules.name: Deathless Noble
sharedRules.description: The model gains Undying Will, Disciplined.

sharedRules.name: Tomb Architect
sharedRules.description: At the beginning of Vanguard Units (Battle Setup, 3.F), and at the start of each friendly Player Turn, choose a friendly unit containing Statue within 18": all models with Statue gains Regeneration (5+). Duration: One Turn.

sharedRules.name: Tomb Harbinger
sharedRules.description:
The model part gains Fury, Lethal Strike. 
 In addition, it counts as a Rank-and-File model for the purposes of Undying Will.

sharedRules.name: Soul Conduit
sharedRules.description:
If the Death Cult Hierarch’s chosen Path of Magic is: 
 • Evocation: whenever the model casts a Spell of Type Augment, Universal on a friendly unit, you may activate Death is only the Beginning on any friendly unit within 18" of the model instead of one of the units the spell was cast on. 
 • Any other Path of Magic: the model knows Whispers of the Veil (Evocation) in addition to its other spells.

sharedRules.name: Death is Only the Beginning
sharedRules.description:
Each time this model successfully casts a Learned Spell of Type Augment, Universal, choose one of the following effects, for a single targeted friendly unit: 
 • The Rank-and-File part of the target Raises a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value. 
 • A single model in the target Recovers a number of HP equal to its Resurrected value. 
 This effect cannot be applied more than twice on the same Health Pool in each Magic Phase.

sharedRules.name: Curse of Phatep
sharedRules.description: Spells cast by this unit gains +12" Range.

sharedRules.name: Chariot of Nephet-Râ
sharedRules.description: The model’s base size is changed to {100\timess{}100} \si{\milli\meter}, it gains two additional \enquote{\skeletalhorse{}} model parts, \alphaorderlistbf{\solitary{}, \fly{}} and loses \textbf{\exclusive{}}.%

sharedRules.name: Sacred Ark
sharedRules.description: Learned Spells cast by friendly Wizards within 12" of one or more models with Sacred Ark gain +6" Range (Aura spells gain +3" Range instead).

sharedRules.name: Eternal Guardian
sharedRules.description: Attacks with Multiple Wounds (X) against the model halve the number of wounds they inflict (rounding fractions up).

sharedRules.name: Legion Charioteers
sharedRules.description: The model loses Light Troops.

sharedRules.name: Ghastly Swarm
sharedRules.description: The model’s Resurrected value is set to 1, and it gains Spirit, Aegis (5+), Aegis (3+ against non-Magical Attacks), Ghost Step, Magical Attacks, and loses Skirmisher, Hard Target (1).

sharedRules.name: Scales of Destiny
sharedRules.description: The model gains Hierophant and Wizard Apprentice with access to Cosmology, Divination, Evocation.

sharedRules.name: Duty is Eternal
sharedRules.description:
The target gains +1 Res.
*The spell targets a single friendly unit that was the target of the original spell.

sharedRules.name: Hierophant
sharedRules.description: An Undying Dynasties army must include at least one model with Hierophant.

sharedRules.name: Dust to Dust
sharedRules.description:
At the end of each of your Player Turns, if there are no friendly models with Hierophant on the Battlefield, each unit containing Dust to Dust loses X HP, where X is equal to half their Resurrected value (rounding fractions up). 
 These hits can only be allocated onto models with Dust to Dust.

sharedRules.name: Ensouled Statue
sharedRules.description: Units entirely with Ensouled Statue reduce by 1 the number of HP lost due to Dust to Dust, Unstable.

sharedRules.name: Undying Will
sharedRules.description:
Rank-and-File model parts with Skeleton in units containing Undying Will gain +2 Def, +2 Off, Magical Attacks,Lethal Strike, and replace their Shooting Weapons’ Aim with (4+). 
 Model parts with Mount are not affected by Undying Will.

sharedRules.name: Autonomous
sharedRules.description: Units entirely with Autonomous may perform March Moves as normal despite being Undead, even when outside the range of the Commanding Presence of any friendly models.

sharedRules.name: Terracotta Army
sharedRules.description:
Models without Statue have their Rsr set to 1, gain +1 Res, Statue, Ensouled Statue, and lose Dust to Dust.
 If an army includes any model with Terracotta Army, then all models in the Army List must have Terracotta Army.

sharedRules.name: Barrow Legion
sharedRules.description:
Unless the model has Height 5, or only has model parts with Beast and/or Statue, it gains +1 Arm, Metal Armour, and loses Light Armour (if it has it). 
 A model with Mount cannot benefit from this +1 Arm more than once.
 If an army includes any model with Barrow Legion, then all models in the Army List must have Barrow Legion.
